data.title: 猫猫 · 夜市药草茶的闻香
data.description: 【后宫外夜市·傍晚】猫猫穿着外出襦裙，在药草茶摊前端起小杯闻香；她用指尖拨开杯沿的香叶，确认不是可疑配方后才小口品尝，蓝瞳里闪过满意的亮光。
data.location: evening herb market outside the palace
data.action: 夜市茶摊先闻香拨开香叶，确认安全后小口品尝露出满意亮光
data.lighting: warm red lantern light after sunset
data.mood: 药师式的夜市美食勘验
data.promptProse: Maomao from The Apothecary Diaries wears a pale rose long-sleeved blouse, dark green ankle-length skirt and small cloth bag. She raises a tiny herbal tea at the evening market and smells it before taking a sip. She separates the floating leaves with one precise fingertip, satisfies her curiosity, and lets a brief glint of approval reach her blue eyes beside the lantern-lit stalls. warm red lantern light after sunset.
